verses.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:
verses.sm: Usai Aitofele ia Apisaloma, So‘u filifilia tagata e sefulu afe ma afe e lua, ma aʻu tulai atu, ma tuliloa ia Tavita i le po nanei;

verses.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
verses.sm: ona ou 00 atu lea ia te ia manu o vaivai ma lē lava o ia, ma ou faamata'u ia te ia; ona sosola ai lea o le nuu uma ua ia te ia, ona ou fasia lea na o le tupu lava.

verses.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.
verses.sm: Ona au faafoisia mai lea o le nuu uma ia te oe; O le tagata o loo E sailia e peiseai ua foi uma mai ai; o le nuu uma e filemu i latou.

verses.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua tonu lava le upu i le manatu o Apisaloma, ma manatu o toeaina uma o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane Apisaloma, Seʻi valaau foi ia Usai le Araki, tatou te faalogologo pe se a sana fetalaiga.

verses.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane lea o Usai ia Apisaloma, ua fai mai Apisaloma ia te ia, ua faapea, Ua faapea mai le fetalaiga a Aitofele; pe tatou te faia ea lana mea? a leai, fetalai mai ia oe.

verses.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Usai ia Apisaloma, E le lelei le pule na pule ai Aitofele i lenci mea.

verses.en: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Usai, Ua e silafia lava lou tama ma onz tagata, O toa i latou; o loo tiga o latou loto, pei o le urosa i le vao ua avea lana toloai; O lou tamā foi o le tagata tau O ia, e le moe o ja faatasi ma le nuu;

verses.en: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
verses.sm: faauta, o loo lafi nei o ia i se tasi lua, po o se tasi mea; a 00 ina fāsia ni o latou i le amataga, ona faapea ane ai lea o i latou o e faalogo i le tala, Ua to le fasi o le nuu ua mulimuli ia Apisaloma;

verses.en: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.
verses.sm: o le tagata malosi foi, o lona loto ua pei o le loto o le leona, e liu suávai o ia, aua ua iloa e Isaraelu uma, o le toa lava lou tamā, o tagata malolosi foi i latou o loo ia te ia.

verses.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
verses.sm: O lenei, o loʻu nei manatu, ia matuā faapotopotoina ia te oe Isaraelu uma lava, e pau mai i Tanu e pau mai i Peresepa, e pei o le oneone o le sami ona toatele; ma ia e afio atu lava Oe i le taua.

verses.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
verses.sm: Ona tatou oo atu lea ia te ia i se tasi mea e maua mai ai o ia, tatou te oo atu ia te ia, e pei ona totō ifo o le sau i le eleele; ona le faasaoina ai lea o se toatasi, O ia ma tagata uma o loo ia te ia.

verses.en: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
verses.sm: A e afai ua oo atu ia i se aai, ona avatua lea e Isaraelu uma i lea aai o maea, tatou te tosina i le alia, seia oo ina le maua ai lava sina maa.

verses.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o Apisaloma ma tagata uma o Isaraelu, E sili ona lelei o le pule a Usai le Araki i le pule a Aitofele; aua ua finagalo le ALII e faaleaogaina le pule lelei a Aitofele, ina JI. SAMUELU 17 ia faaoo e le Aw le malaia ia Apisaloma.

verses.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Usai ia Satoka ma Aviata o faitaulaga, Ua faapea ona pule o Aitofele ia Apisaloma ma toeaina o Isaraelu, ma ua faapea la'u pule.

verses.en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia aau faataalise atu nisi, ma taʻu atu ai ia Tavita, ia faapea, Aua le aoina Oe i le eleele laugatasi i le vao; a ia vave ona e alu atu, neʻi faaumatia le tupu, ma le nuu uma o loo ia te ia.

verses.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
verses.sm: Sa nonofo Ionatana ma Aimaasu i Enerokelu, ua alu atu ai le auauna fafine e ta‘u atu ia te i laua; ona la o atu lea e ta‘u atu ai i le tupu o Tavita; aua e le mafai ona la faailoa atu o i laua i le aai.

verses.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
verses.sm: A ua iloa i laua e le tasi taulealea, ona ia ta‘u atu lea ia Apisaloma; a ua la vave atu, ma la o i le fale o le tagata Pauri, sa ia te ia le vaieli i lona lotoà, ua la o ifo ai.

verses.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
verses.sm: Ona avatu lea e le fafine, ma na fofola se mea e ufiufi a‘i le gutu o le vaieli, ona folafola lea i ona luga o saito ua oloina; ua le iloa e se tasi le togafiti.

verses.en: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ona oo atu lea o auauna a Apisaloma i le fafine i le fale, ua latou fai mai, O i fea Aimaasu ma lonatana? Ua fai mai le fafine ia te i latou, Ua sopoia atu i laua i le vaitafe. Ua latou sailia, a ua le maua, ona latou foi lea i lerusalema.

verses.en: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
verses.sm: Ua oo ina ua 6 i latou, ona o ae lea o i laua ai le vaieli; ua la o ma taʻu ane i le tupu o Tavita; ua la faapea mai foi ia Tavita, Tulai ia, ma outou vave atu i le itu vai, aua na faapea ona pule o Aitofele ia te outou.

verses.en: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Tavita ma le nuu uma sa ia te ia, ua latou sopoia atu Ioritana. Ua oo ina malama ae le taeao, ua le toe ai lava se tasi ua le sopoia atu loritana.

verses.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Aitofele ua le faia lana pule, ona ia faanofoaina lea o lana asini, ua tulai, ma alu atu i lona fale i lona lava nuu; na tofi e ia ana mea i lona aiga, ona noa ai lea o ia ia te ia, ua ou ai; ona tanu ai lea o ia i le tuugamau o lona tama.

verses.en: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu Tavita i Maanaima; ua sopoia atu foi Apisaloma i Ioritana, o ia atoa ma tagata Isaraelu uma faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.
verses.sm: Ona tofia lea o Amase e Apisaloma ia pule i ‘au e sui a‘i Ioapo; o Amase foi o le atalii o le tasi tagata e igoa ia Ietero, o le sa Isaraelù, o le na alu atu ia Apikaila le afafine o Naasa, le uso O Seruia, le tiná o Ioapo.

verses.en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
verses.sm: Ua to lauapi Isaraelu ma Apisaloma i le nuu o Kiliata.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
verses.sm: Pa oo atu Tavita i Maanaima, ona avatu lea e Sopi le atalii o Naasa (mai Rapa, o le aai a le fanauga a Amoni), ma Makira le atalii o Amueli mai Lotapara, ma Pasili le Kiliata mai Rokeli,

verses.en: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
verses.sm: o moega, ma ipu, ma ipu omea, ma saito, ma karite, ma falaoa, ma saito tunu, ma fua o fue, ma atasema, ma karite tunu,

verses.en: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.
verses.sm: ma meli, ma suāsusu toʻa, ma mamoe, ma suásusu maaa O povi, na aumaia má Tavita ma le nuu ua ia te ia, latou te aai ai; auá na latou faapea ane, Ua fia aai le nuu, ma ua vaivai, ma fia inu i le vao.
